routes.label: Recover the whole from equal fourths

question: Calculate: \(12 \div (\frac{3}{4}) = ?\)
solution: \(\frac{3}{4}\) of a number is 12. These are three equal fourths, so one fourth is \(12 \div 3 = 4\), and four fourths total \(4 \times 4 = 16\). The number is \(12 \div \frac{3}{4} = 16\).
